title: Grade the Score
goal: Sixty passes. Fix the comparison and make the if produce the value.
hints: Every choice compiles except two. The tests know which boundary matters.
A single = is assignment, not comparison.
explanation: Two failures hide here. `> 60` compiles but fails the boundary test: sixty should pass, so the comparison is `>= 60`. And the branch value must be a bare expression: `"pass";` ends with a semicolon, making the branch `()` while the else branch is `&str` - E0308. Off-by-one bugs compile; that is what tests are for.
